title: Product Delivery Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The **Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Product Owner / Business Data Analyst** bridges business strategy and technical execution across Citi's data and analytics ecosystem. This role drives the product delivery lifecycle for data platforms, reporting solutions, and analytical tools while executing hands\-on data modeling, SQL querying, and visual analytics in Tableau. The role requires strong agile ownership, data governance discipline, and adherence to Citi's risk and control standards.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  

**1\. Product Ownership \& Agile Delivery**

  

  

* **Backlog \& Sprint Execution:** Own, prioritize, and manage the Jira product backlog; align sprint deliverables with product roadmaps, business priorities, and stakeholder commitments.
* **User Stories \& Requirements:** Author detailed user stories with clear acceptance criteria (BDD/Gherkin format) and functional specifications for engineering teams.
* **Agile Ceremonies:** Participate in and facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and sprint retrospectives with Scrum Masters and developers.
* **UAT \& Release Validation:** Define UAT test scenarios, coordinate business testing cycles, and support production release readiness.
  

  

**2\. Business \& Data Analysis, Modeling \& Visualization**

  

  

* **Data Modeling (Tableau \& SQL):** Build and maintain data models, semantic layers, and relationships (joins, blending, LOD calculations) to support multi\-dimensional reporting.
* **SQL Data Analysis:** Write complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, subqueries, analytical/window functions) across relational and enterprise data warehouses to extract, validate, and analyze datasets.
* **Dashboarding \& Report Visualization:** Design, build, and optimize interactive, production\-ready dashboards in **Tableau** (or PowerBI) to visualize financial, operational, performance, and risk metrics.
* **Business Process Analysis:** Translate business workflows, transaction flows, and financial reporting requirements (e.g., P\&L, balance sheet trends) into clear data and functional specifications.

**3\. Data Governance, Risk \& Controls**


* **Governance Standards:** Apply Citi's Data Management Standard, define Critical Data Elements (CDEs), and establish data quality validation rules.
* **Lineage \& Traceability:** Maintain data lineage, metadata definitions, and data dictionaries to ensure transparency.
* **Risk \& Audit Readiness:** Ensure all project documentation, change controls, and SDLC artifacts comply with Citi’s internal risk and audit standards.

**4\. Stakeholder Collaboration \& Adoption**


* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with business partners, finance leaders, and risk teams to gather requirements, communicate sprint progress, and manage feedback.
* **User Enablement \& Training:** Prepare user guides, conduct demo sessions, and support change management to drive adoption of analytics solutions.
  

  

**Qualifications \& Competencies**

  

  

**Education \& Experience**

  

  

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Data Analytics, or related field.
* **Experience:**7\+ years in agile product ownership, business analysis, or data analytics within financial services.
  

  

**Technical \& Analytical Skills**

  

  

* **Tableau:** Strong hands\-on proficiency in Tableau Desktop and Server (data modeling, LOD calculations, dashboard creation, performance optimization).
* **SQL \& Databases:** Strong SQL skills with experience querying relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) or cloud/enterprise data platforms.
* **Data Visualization \& Modeling:** Demonstrated ability to build intuitive reports and robust data models from disparate data sources.
* **Agile \& Tools:** Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for user story mapping, backlog management, and documentation.
* **Data Governance:** Working knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality controls.
  

  

**Soft Skills**

  

  

* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical and data requirements clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Proactive, structured approach to data analysis and problem resolution.

title: Senior Software Engineering Lead - Java FSE
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

A highly experienced Full Stack Engineer with 10\+ years of expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Cloud Platforms (GCP/Azure), responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable, high\-performance enterprise applications.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture
* Build and optimize event\-driven and real\-time data processing solutions using Apache Kafka, ensuring scalability, reliability, and fault tolerance
* Lead architecture discussions and contribute to technical design, solutioning, and technology roadmaps
* Develop secure, reusable, and high\-quality code following industry best practices, coding standards, and design patterns
* Implement and manage cloud\-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, leveraging services for compute, storage, networking, and monitoring
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
* Drive application modernization initiatives, including migration from monolithic systems to microservices and cloud platforms
* Ensure application reliability through performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support activities
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and DevOps best practices to accelerate software delivery
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote engineering excellence across development teams
* Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards while delivering resilient and scalable solutions
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to planning, estimation, and successful project execution
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in software design, development, and support of enterprise applications
* Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, including Core Java, Multithreading, Collections, JVM tuning, and design patterns
* Extensive experience developing microservices\-based applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, and RESTful APIs
* Proven experience implementing event\-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, Kafka Streams, topic management, and performance tuning
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and/or Microsoft Azure, including deployment, monitoring, and cloud\-native services
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes  

Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms
* Experience in Agile/Scrum development methodologies and working within cross\-functional teams
* Solid knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or BigQuery
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resilience, security, and performance optimization
* Proven excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills
* Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with technical and business stakeholders
* Skills \& Competencies:
	+ Solid expertise in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, and Kafka
	+ Hands\-on experience with GCP and/or Azure cloud services
	+ Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevOps practices
	+ Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and event\-driven design
	+ Proven excellent problem\-solving, leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills
* Leadership Expectations:
	+ Ability to lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design decisions
	+ Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving engineering best practices
	+ Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering high\-quality, scalable, and reliable solutions
	+ Solid collaboration and stakeholder management skills in a fast\-paced enterprise environment.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant cloud certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Developer, Microsoft Azure Developer Associate, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, ARM Templates, or Bicep)
* Experience in cloud migration, modernization, and application transformation initiatives
* Experience with API gateways, service mesh technologies, and event streaming platforms
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, or Cloud Monitoring
* Exposure to AI/ML\-enabled products, data engineering pipelines, or large\-scale analytics platforms

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Agile Scrum Master Senior_7+Yrs_Pune
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**

  

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for **Agile Scrum Master Senior** to join our ever\-evolving **Quantum** **team** and help shape the future of global commerce.

  

As a Scrum Master you will be working with teams responsible for building, releasing and operating products for the business. This role means that you take on significant leadership and coaching responsibilities within sprint teams and the organization. As a Scrum Master, you have a specialization towards coaching development teams, Product Owners, stakeholders and managers in agile practices and values.

* The Scrum Master is a servant leader who enables our Agile teams to self\-organize, self\-manage, and deliver via effective Lean\-Agile practices.
* You will be educating and mentoring the teams in Scrum, Kanban, SAFe and other Agile methods ensuring that the agreed upon Agile process is being followed to deliver value to customers.
* You will be responsible for facilitating the team\-level events and assisting the Release Train Engineer (RTE) for train\-level events.
* Removing impediments and foster an environment for high\-performing team dynamics, continuous flow, and relentless improvement.
* The Scrum Master also helps the team coordinate with other teams on the Agile Release Train (ART) and communicates status to management as needed.
* You will understand Agile and SAFe values and demonstrate them continuously.

 **What you’ll bring**

* Exceptional working knowledge in Agile technology delivery and tools
* An inquisitive personality that is always looking for constant improvement opportunities
* Strong mentoring, coaching and leadership skills
* Good working experience in an Agile environment, preferably in SAFe, Scrum and/or Kanban
* Experience working across multiple technical, software, or business unit teams to develop software solutions
* Ability to understand business and technology concepts quickly and able to facilitate those conversations
* Agile certifications

 **It’s a bonus if you have**

* Experience in SAFe Agile framework
* Exposure to the Payments industry domain (especially Cards and other payment schemes)
* Experience working in a team developing microservices and/or web applications

 **About the team**


Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

 **What makes a Globalpayer?**  

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.  

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer.


Apply now to take your career global.
